S6CO00556.name: Bob Chew
S6CO00556.bio: Former Navy officer and businessman who spent 35 years in the life sciences industry.

positions.stance: Says Social Security and Medicare face insolvency and lists over a dozen reform options; "Reform must happen in the next six years!"
Pledges to introduce debt-reduction legislation in his first year, combining spending restraint, entitlement reform, tax reform, and dedicating new revenue to debt reduction.
Calls for cutting waste and fraud, reducing the debt, entitlement reform, and tax reform "to bring in more revenue from the wealthiest Americans."
Calls for "a practical, honest conversation about how to deliver better care at lower cost while preserving the innovation and quality that Americans depend on."
Supports removing violent criminals and cartel traffickers while not expending resources "pursuing peaceful immigrants who contribute to our economy."

S6CO00564.name: Adam Withrow
S6CO00564.bio: Has worked as a ranch hand, CNA, cook, contractor, and detention officer.

positions.stance: Says "fossil fuels are obsolete" and calls for paving the way for a smooth transition to future energy technology starting today.
Calls for reimagining the health care system to "create one that works for everyone," arguing corporate profits have taken priority over health.
Opposes war, "every war"; says free trade and global recognition of equality will accomplish what bombs cannot.
States his "first priority is to raise pay for all workers and tie that amount to the Consumer Price Index."

S6MN00572.name: Rebecca Whiting
S6MN00572.bio: Army combat veteran and former medic, small business owner, and homeschooling mother from Bemidji, Minnesota.

positions.stance: "No more wars. Unless the United States is attacked, we have no business using our military in foreign countries."
"No more entangling alliances"; says allies should run their own countries without U.S. dollars.
"Bring the troops home"; says the military should not be used as a tool of the military industrial complex.
Supports a policy of non-intervention: "The world's conflicts are not ours to police."
Calls the VA "a failed system" and supports privatizing it so the free market gives veterans faster access to care.

S6SC04247.name: Kasie Whitener
S6SC04247.bio: Writer, business owner, radio host, and clinical assistant professor at the University of South Carolina.

positions.stance: Plans to fix the national debt by simplifying the tax code, reforming Social Security and Medicare, cutting federal spending 5% across agencies, and growing the economy.
Supports "abundance in healthcare by removing costly government interventions," separating insurance from employment, and more free-market options.
Supports "better oversight of the Executive branch – fight corruption and grift."
"No more foreign wars."
Supports "better immigration laws based on sound economic principles."

S6KY00377.name: Christopher Campbell
S6KY00377.bio: Union member (Local 1076), Kentucky National Guard veteran, and longtime health care worker.

positions.stance: Supports Medicare for All, calling health care "a basic human right."
Pro-labor and pro-union; says workers deserve safe workplaces, excellent benefits, quality pay, and a way to address grievances without retaliation.
Will push for a constitutional "Green" Amendment establishing the government's duty to ensure a safe, healthy environment.
Will push for U.S. ratification of several United Nations treaties to make the nation a leader in protecting civil liberties.
Says reproductive care is health care and a constitutionally protected right; "no American citizen should be deprived of it."

S2OR00234.name: Chris Henry
S2OR00234.bio: Long-haul union truck driver, former aircraft mechanic, and co-chair of the Oregon Progressive Party.

positions.stance: "Tax The Rich AND Jail The Cayman Island Offshoring Tax-Dodgers!"
Supports campaign finance reform, ad disclosures, ranked choice voting, multi-member districts, and a unicameral legislature.
Supports creating an Oregon State Bank and publicly owned municipal banks, and divesting from Wall Street.
Supports a living wage, including a $15 standard and $20 prevailing minimum wage, a 10:1 maximum wage ratio, and stronger overtime laws.
Supports publicly funded education from daycare and pre-K through trade guilds, higher education, and lifelong learning.
"Congress must authorize war"; demands strict adherence to the War Powers Resolution of 1973.
Says affordable domestic energy affects groceries, transportation, utilities, jobs, and family budgets.
Says "healthcare should not bankrupt working families" and reform should serve patients, nurses, providers, and small businesses, not giant corporate systems.
Supports securing the border, streamlining deportation, and a constitutional, enforceable immigration process passed by Congress.
"Patients before systems"; describes himself as "a staunch advocate for health freedom and alternative medical choices."

wiki:curtis-stinnett.name: Curtis Stinnett
wiki:curtis-stinnett.bio: Pharmacist with a Doctor of Pharmacy who has practiced in community pharmacy across Oklahoma.

positions.stance: Supports passing the Equal Rights Amendment through Congress again for state ratification; "Until we guarantee equal rights by law, we do not have equal rights."
Says "we must stop all military aid to the country of Israel" until it stops its campaign and begins restitution.
Would vote against ICE appropriations under current practices; supports more judicial resources and higher immigration quotas.
Proposes tying the federal minimum wage to the MIT Living Wage Calculator, county by county, reevaluated every year.
Would switch the U.S. to a Medicare for All system, rolling Medicaid, TriCare, and VA into Medicare.

S6IA00181.name: Thomas Laehn
S6IA00181.bio: Former university professor and Greene County Attorney.

positions.stance: Says he is "running against the two-party system itself" and will sponsor legislation to eliminate PACs and super PACs from elections.
Will work to prohibit private companies from using eminent domain to seize property for commercial gain.
Will fight to bring troops home and block wars declared by presidents without the consent of Congress.
Will fight to restore the constitutional balance of powers and return legislative power to Congress.
Will vote against funding measures that increase the national debt except in extreme emergency, and supports a balanced budget amendment.

S6AR00223.name: Jeff Wadlin
S6AR00223.bio: Engineer and businessman who co-founded an online auto parts salvage company and worked at Caterpillar and Capital One.

positions.stance: Wants to eliminate broad tariffs, end wars of aggression, enforce antitrust laws, and support gradual, predictable minimum-wage increases.
Goal is to "cover everyone, which requires cutting the total cost of healthcare roughly in half over time" through a public-private partnership.
Opposes broad tariffs, supports strong crop insurance, a durable Farm Bill, farmers' right to repair, and confronting agribusiness consolidation.
Supports a balanced-budget amendment, a statutory debt brake, and gradually adding personal investment accounts to Social Security for younger generations.
Supports a simpler, progressive tax system, eliminating special-interest loopholes, and not funding tax cuts with borrowed money.

S4MS00187.name: Ty Pinkins
S4MS00187.bio: Retired U.S. Army veteran of 21 years and attorney with a J.D. and LL.M. from Georgetown.

positions.stance: Will ensure federal farm bills are written with small family farmers in mind and work to bring good-paying jobs to every corner of Mississippi.
Supports the Medicare for All Act, saying "healthcare is a fundamental human right—not a privilege."
Will fight for affordable housing, updated FEMA rules for Gulf Coast homeowners, and new construction and rehabilitation of older homes.
Will work to "ensure every child has access to a high-quality public education," including raising teacher salaries and investing in affordable pre-K.

S6NE00202.name: Chuck Conboy
S6NE00202.bio: Has worked in management and sales and as vice president of a local meatpackers and butchers union.

positions.stance: Supports securing the southern border, expanding enforcement, deporting criminals, and training hardworking immigrants to become productive members of society.
Wants Congress to act now on Social Security's projected insolvency, with "no cuts to benefits."
"No more endless foreign wars" and "no more blank checks to foreign governments at the expense of Americans."
Wants affordable higher education, an end to crushing student debt, and a return of trade schools.
Wants to bring down the cost of living, make childcare affordable, and rebuild a strong middle class.

S6NE00152.name: Mike Marvin
S6NE00152.bio: Former Omaha city bus driver and former executive director of the NAPE/AFSCME state employees union.

positions.stance: Supports legalizing marijuana nationwide for medical and recreational purposes.
Promises to repeal the PATRIOT Act and reestablish Americans' right to privacy.
Says the United States "must no longer participate in these foreign entanglements."
Supports overturning Citizens United, publicly funded elections, and banning stock trading and post-office lobbying by elected officials.
Pledges to eliminate the Social Security income cap and expand Medicare and Medicaid to eventually cover every American.

S4NE00207.name: Dan Osborn
S4NE00207.bio: Navy veteran, former Kellogg's industrial mechanic, and former president of union BCTGM Local 50G.

positions.stance: Says he "will champion the strongest anti-corruption platform Washington has ever seen."
Will take on corporations to restore economic fairness for workers; says "no one should go bankrupt from medical debt."
Will "cut waste, end corporate welfare, and refuse to vote for spending we can't afford."
Will take on corporate monopolies and "fight to restore real markets in our agricultural system."
Says as an Independent he can take positions neither party would and will champion policies that "turn down the political temperature."

S6NE00210.name: Robin Richards
S6NE00210.bio: Ralston school board member and consultant who led Little Bird Consulting LLC.

positions.stance: Says working families, small businesses, farms, and ranches "need a government focused on the real cost of getting by."
Will fight for an approach that "puts people and their ability to get care ahead of institutional loyalty."
Says "our public schools deserve the support to serve every community."
Believes "practical government should help make housing people can actually live in possible."
Says leaders should represent voters, not endorsing organizations, and that she "will not disappear to Washington."

S6ID00146.name: Todd Achilles
S6ID00146.bio: Former U.S. Army tank commander and armor officer raised on a family farm.

positions.stance: Supports term limits for Congress and the Supreme Court, a ban on members trading individual stocks, and a five-year lobbying ban.
Supports eliminating waste, fraud, and abuse, recovering revenue owed, and closing tax loopholes used by elites and corporations.
Will work to lower taxes for working families, small businesses, and ag producers, and supports banning predatory non-compete agreements.
Will protect health care tax credits, ban drug-company kickbacks to doctors, require upfront pricing, and work to increase housing supply.
Opposes selling Idaho's public lands to fund federal spending: "Not One Damn Acre!"

S6ID00187.name: Matt Loesby
S6ID00187.bio: Former video game developer living in Idaho's Treasure Valley.

positions.stance: Says "the Global American Empire must end, immediately" and he will do everything he can to weaken its power.
Says families, churches, and communities must rebuild voluntary social institutions, and he can help abolish laws that tear them apart.
"Close the Border. End Birthright Citizenship." Supports admitting only immigrants invited by U.S. citizen landowners who take financial responsibility.
"Bring all the troops all the way home. End all proxy wars"; opposes foreign aid to any country.
"End the Federal Reserve. Return To Sound Money"; will push to audit and then end the Fed and cut budgets across the board.

S6WV00204.name: S. Marshall Wilson
S6WV00204.bio: Retired Army infantry officer, pastor, and former member of the West Virginia House of Delegates.

positions.stance: Will fight to "unleash West Virginia's energy economy, cut regulations that strangle small businesses," and put families first.
Will vote against every budget that doesn't balance and never vote to raise the debt ceiling without real cuts.
Will be a Senate vote "that never flinches when it comes to the Bill of Rights, the sovereignty of West Virginia."

S2NH00223.name: Edmond J. LaPlante Jr.
S2NH00223.bio: Mechanic of over 40 years, Marine veteran, and current school board member.

positions.stance: Says it is time to end U.S. involvement in wars abroad and stop sending foreign aid overseas.
Says veterans' care is a clear federal responsibility, while civilian health care, mental health, and addiction treatment should be led by states.
Calls for restoring constitutional boundaries, full transparency, and accountability for agencies like the Federal Reserve and fusion centers.
Supports enforcing existing immigration laws and says people in the country illegally should not receive state or federal benefits.
Proposes expanding homeschooling freedom and strengthening parents' right to guide their children's education.

S6MT00261.name: Kyle Austin
S6MT00261.bio: Pharmacist and independent pharmacy owner who owns his family's farm on Montana's Hi-Line.

positions.stance: Says his number one priority is to pull the roughly $66.9 million in federal funding to Montana's Department of Labor and Industry.
Will work to overhaul the USDA, including 0% financing for ag producers and infrastructure such as railways, highways, and fertilizer production.
Believes every American should have "un-restricted access to bear arms."
Plans to overhaul the health care system "to improve access and quality to all United States citizens."

S6MT00287.name: Seth Bodnar
S6MT00287.bio: Former Army Green Beret and businessman who served eight years as President of the University of Montana.

positions.stance: Opposes the war in Iran; supports reasserting Congress's authority to declare war and a War Powers Resolution vote.
Supports targeted tariffs against countries cheating on trade but opposes blanket tariffs on allies like Canada.
Supports capping insulin at $35 a month, restoring enhanced ACA subsidies, defending Medicaid expansion, and expanding Medicare drug-price negotiation.
Supports stopping data centers that raise power bills or threaten water, and giving communities authority to reject them.
Supports operational control of the border, enforcing existing immigration laws, cracking down on cartels, and fixing legal immigration.

S6RI00288.name: Michael Bahry
S6RI00288.bio: Former construction executive and business owner, nonprofit founder, and theology instructor at Salve Regina University.

positions.stance: Believes open, respectful discussion of faith "can and should contribute to how policy is formed and how budgets are formulated."
Will make "ending war and international conflicts his focus" if elected.
Says an independent can vote issue-by-issue "based purely on what is right" and bring Democrats and Republicans together.
Supports congressional term limits to counter incumbency advantages and reduce special-interest influence.
Says ending wars frees trillions for infrastructure, innovation, and education, and enables global collaboration on climate solutions.
